title: The Missing Root: Geometric Imagination Without Images in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33841v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper proposes a new paradigm and method for giving large language models spatial understanding. Standard language models operate exclusively over discrete words (secondary representations of things rather than continuous space itself), forcing them to guess geometry verbally. Whereas most multimodal approaches equate spatial grounding with camera images or video frames, spatial structure itself is not a picture: it consists of coordinate frames, solid boundaries, and how objects move and relate to each other in continuous space. Motivated by this distinction, we place continuous object tokens combining pose (position, orientation, and scale) and signed-distance shape embeddings alongside word tokens inside a single uninterrupted transformer sequence, allowing language and geometry to attend to each other as object scenes are built and updated step by step. Control tokens switch output automatically between natural-language words

translated_title: 缺失的根基：大型语言模型中无需图像的几何想象
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种赋予大型语言模型空间理解能力的新范式和新方法。标准语言模型仅在离散词语上运行（词语是事物的二次表示，而非连续空间本身），迫使它们只能通过语言来猜测几何信息。大多数多模态方法将空间接地等同于相机图像或视频帧，但空间结构本身并不是一幅图像：它由坐标框架、实体边界以及物体在连续空间中如何运动和相互关联所构成。基于这一区别，我们将结合位姿（位置、方向和尺度）与带符号距离形状嵌入的连续物体token，与词语token一同放置在单一不间断的transformer序列中，使语言和几何能够在物体场景逐步构建和更新的过程中相互关注。控制token可在自然语言词语……之间自动切换输出。
tldr: 该论文提出将包含位姿与带符号距离形状嵌入的连续物体token嵌入transformer序列，使大型语言模型无需依赖图像即可获得真正的空间几何理解能力。
en_tdlr: This paper embeds continuous object tokens combining pose and signed-distance shape embeddings into transformer sequences, enabling large language models to achieve genuine spatial-geometric understanding without relying on images.
